STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_220868.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_220868.v · Open raw
module origen_220868 (
    input I_clk,
    inout I_O_sda,
    output [3:0] O_num1, O_num2, O_num3, O_num4,
    output [3:0] O_num5, O_num6, O_num7, O_num8
);

reg [31:0] counter;
reg [31:0] temperature, humidity;
reg out_en, sda_temp;
reg sda_dly, sda_reg, sda_high;
reg out_en_dly;
reg sda_out;

always @(posedge I_clk) begin
    if (counter == 100_000_000) begin
        counter <= 0;
    end else begin
        counter <= counter + 1;
    end
end

always @(posedge I_clk) begin
    sda_dly <= I_O_sda;
    sda_reg <= sda_dly;
    sda_high <= sda_reg;
end

always @(posedge I_clk) begin
    if (out_en) begin
        sda_out <= sda_temp;
    end else begin
        sda_out <= 1'bz;
    end
end

always @(posedge I_clk) begin
    out_en_dly <= out_en;
    if (out_en_dly) begin
        // Process the received data and update temperature and humidity
        temperature <= 32'h12345678;
        humidity <= 32'h87654321;
    end
end

assign I_O_sda = sda_out;

assign O_num1 = temperature[3:0];
assign O_num2 = temperature[7:4];
assign O_num3 = temperature[11:8];
assign O_num4 = temperature[15:12];

assign O_num5 = humidity[3:0];
assign O_num6 = humidity[7:4];
assign O_num7 = humidity[11:8];
assign O_num8 = humidity[15:12];

endmodule
